title: The adjective: degrees of comparison, the short form

blocks.text: A word that modifies a noun or noun phrase or describes a noun’s referent.
A form of an adjective that indicates a different degree of the attribute the adjective denotes; like the positive, comparative and superlative forms.
The degree of comparison of an adjective or adverb used when comparing two entities in terms of a certain property or a certain way of doing something.
The degree of comparison of an adjective or adverb used when comparing three or more entities in terms of a certain property or a certain way of doing something.
краткая форма — short form of an adjective
Particularly in Slavic languages, a shortened form of the adjective, used predicatively.
Exercises: which term each definition is of. Review Terms, at the foot of the page, drills this module's terms.
